services.name: Pony Riding Experience
services.desc: Included in experince: tour of farm time spent grooming and bonding with the pony a ride around the farm and lots of photo oppertunities Inspire a lifelong love of horses in your child with a safe and fun, hand-led pony ride. We have friendly ponies available for children 1- 5 years old who weigh less than 60 pounds. Our pony rides are designed for nervous, first-time riders and consist of some time getting to know the pony on the ground and then some riding time in the saddle. Our goal is to get the child comfortable on the pony with plenty of photo ops for parents and grandparents. services.name: Introductive Educational Horse Experience
services.desc: Learn, Connect and Interact with our horses! This introduction into the art of connecting with horses is the ultimate horse experience for all ages. We designed this educational experience to meet the needs of anyone interested in horses. The goal is for guests to walk away feeling that they had an opportunity to connect with our amazing animals. Handling and riding the horses and ponies is encouraged during the program, however, it is not required to enjoy the experience. This is an hour-long educational experience, during which you will learn about what it takes to care for and ride horses. services.desc: The Ultimate horse experience for all! Take a wonderful horseback ride though Florida’s finest horse park. Learn about horses and the Tampa Bay Area. Pinellas Park is a beautiful horse community with public horseback riding trail and parks just minutes away from St Petersburg, Clearwater and Tampa. All Levels of rider welcome beginner to advance. This Ride is perfect for first time riders. But even the most advanced rider will enjoy the experience. We require 2 riders minimum per time slot to run the Ride. blurb: Cypress Breeze Farm provides horseback riding experiences for all ages and levels, including trail rides, hand-led pony rides for young kids or nervous riders, and horse-themed educational encounters. Lessons are offered for beginners through advanced riders, and small group sizes ensure personalized experiences. The farm also offers horse-drawn carriage rides for holiday events and private bookings. Some offerings can be brought off-site for events.
